justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java and searched the repo for LazyParameterDescription. The class is a private nested type inside LazyMethodDescription, and the only instantiation found is in LazyParameterList.get(int) at lines 8465-8472; no references exist outside TypePool.java. Its dependencies are confined to the enclosing method state and a few local helpers (parameterNames, parameterModifiers, parameterTypeDescriptors, parameterTypeAnnotationTokens, parameterAnnotationTokens, signatureResolution, typePool), so it does not show the high fan-in/high fan-out pattern of a hub-like modularization smell.
